scope: Quickstart discovery receipt to persisted admin catalog-draft review journey
claims: A matching successful discovery receipt deterministically creates one persisted non-orderable catalog preview.
Receipt identity, cleanup, output hash, and catalog identity are verified before the draft changes.
The transition is idempotent and uses compare-and-swap persistence to reject concurrent drift.
The admin review page shows discovery evidence, cleanup status, catalog metadata, capabilities, blockers, and pipeline progress.
non_claims: The admin UI does not dispatch the isolated discovery worker.
No artifact, security, model, target, lifecycle, approval, or publication gate has passed.
No catalog item was published and no lab or cluster was changed.
